records.statement: `outdated` resolves the full extends chain before reporting versions, so a Feature contributed by a parent link appears in the report.
records.notes: The pinned reference does not resolve `extends`, so it reports an EMPTY table and exits 0 for a workspace whose only Feature is declared one link up — a silent miss, not an error (observed 2026-07-26, src-obs-outdated-extends-chain). Backed by wvr-outdated-extends-chain-features; the difference is only visible on stdout, so that is the compared channel.

records.statement: `outdated` reports each configured Feature's current, wanted, and latest version, and reports an empty result for a configuration that declares no Features.
records.notes: Assertions pin `current` and `wanted`, which the configuration's exact version reference fixes; `latest` is deliberately unpinned because it is whatever the registry publishes next and an assertion on it would decay into a false failure.
